subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Although I had a well-paid job, I decided to (a) ------- it and start a nursery of my own. Now, planting, grafting, and taking care of saplings are my full-time work. I enjoy walking among the trees and watching the moonlight from a small (b) ------- inside the nursery. Each season brings something new, and I enjoy them all. After quitting my old job, I can’t imagine how I survived in that (c) ------- office for so long. I love being outdoors and close to nature. Gadgets never (d) ------- me, and I don’t think they ever will. Though I’m unmarried, I cook my food and do everything myself. My friends often suggest I should hire a (e) -------, but I prefer to remain self-dependent and enjoy my simple lifestyle. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) leave; (b) hut; (c) stuffy; (d) attract; (e) maid;
